title: Flame Weapon VFX
description: Flame Weapon VFX. Milestone 2 credit burn, v1.0. Projectile is an 8×64 strip. Charge, static AOE, and hit are 1-frame images (AOE pose 96×96). `vfx-flame-aoe-explode` is the 8×96 ground burst, once, origin (0.5, 0.75). Does not replace live hero weapon sheets (fx-sling-pellet, frost, flame, bubble, lightning). Water was not part of this export. SFX keys are notes only; no audio files.

assets.note: v1.0. 8-frame fly strip. Does not replace live flame sheets. PixelLab object c8a68e24-12e4-4fa1-b1f9-e180890d5c9e. SFX `sfx-weapon-flame-shot` (index note only; no audio file).
v1.0. Static 1-frame charge. Static 1-frame. Stage can tween or scale. PixelLab object 75a2591e-8657-4048-af3b-b22dc57efbb7. SFX `sfx-weapon-flame-charge` (index note only; no audio file).

v1.0. Static 1-frame AOE impact pose, kept as the fallback. Animated ground burst is `vfx-flame-aoe-explode` (8×96, origin (0.5, 0.75)). PixelLab object fba3ca31-56ec-406e-91af-18e1763420a8. SFX `sfx-weapon-flame-aoe` (index note only; no audio file).
v1.0. Static 1-frame hit. PixelLab object 7e176c02-1ad7-490f-87ed-058bffc802e6. SFX `sfx-weapon-flame-hit` (index note only; no audio file).

v1.0. 8×96 ground burst, once, origin (0.5, 0.75). Alternate foot hint (0.5, 0.85). Fire ring that expands, then ember and smoke fade. Same PixelLab object as `vfx-flame-aoe` (fba3ca31-56ec-406e-91af-18e1763420a8); burst group e721b6c7-8f26-4275-9aab-3a47d22667b0. Static `vfx-flame-aoe` stays. SFX `sfx-weapon-flame-aoe-explode` (index note only; no audio file).
